1840company-1840-company:lever:f29d8d8d-.title: Cash Application Specialist
1840company-1840-company:lever:f29d8d8d-.description: We are looking for a Cash Applications Specialist who will support daily cash application operations, including payment research, reconciliation, and resolution of payment inquiries across multiple systems. This is a temporary position through June 2026, with the possibility of extension based on business needs. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, accuracy-driven environment with high transaction volumes.
responsibilities: Perform daily cash application research and support cash inflow management activities.
Conduct research on payment inquiry requests submitted by other departments, reviewing supporting documentation and identifying required next steps.
Investigate aged and complex items on the unapplied cash dashboard, focusing on older payments requiring deeper review and resolution.
Assist with resolving unapplied, misapplied, or unidentified payments using multiple internal systems and tools.
Maintain accurate documentation of findings, updates, and resolution actions related to payment inquiries.
Manage and distribute email communications related to cash application and payment research.
Utilize a cash application dashboard daily to track, prioritize, and resolve open items.
Collaborate closely with the Cash Application team to ensure timely and accurate resolution of inquiries.
Demonstrate strong time management, follow-up, and responsiveness to meet service-level expectations in a fast-paced environment.
qualifications: Prior office or administrative experience in a finance, accounting, or operations environment preferred.
Strong proficiency in Excel (VLOOKUPs and Pivot Tables).
Strong Excel skills and comfort working with data, dashboards, and multiple systems.
Quick learner with the ability to navigate new tools and processes efficiently.
Detail-oriented with a strong focus on accuracy and organization.
Strong written communication skills and professional email etiquette.
Proactive, reliable, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:c3.title: Engineering Apprentice I
crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:c3.description: Come join our collaborative and innovative team at DIS-TRAN Packaged Substations! DIS-TRAN Packaged Substations has been an industry leader in the design and supply of high-voltage, open-air substations, and switchyards since 1965. Over a half-century of building meaningful relationships with our customers and vendors boils down to one thing: people. We take pride in our collaborative approach where everything we do is designed to deliver the project the right way, your way. Though we have grown over the years, and now offer new innovations like our Factory-Built Substations, our age-old commitment will never change: to take care of you like family. The Design Engineer (DE) shall be a member of a project engineering team responsible for completing assigned tasks within the allotted schedule and cost constraints. The Design Engineer shall report directly to the Manager of the Engineering Department who is responsible for managing the engineering and design schedules and supervising team members. The Design Engineer shall be fully capable and willing to perform all tasks assigned by the Manager of the Engineering Department. The Design Engineer shall be the single person on the Engineering and Design Team who is responsible and accountable for all aspects related to the structural and physical substation design of the project. The engineer is expected to be knowlegable in all aspects of substation design, including structural steel, foundations, rigid and flexible bus design, substation layout, electrical clearance and safety requirements, and equipment functions and their purpose. The engineer assigned to perform the structural calculations on a project is expected to follow the project throughout the design process, supporting the design team and providing technical advice. The engineer shall provide guidance, direction, instruction, and leadership to the design team pertaining to technical issues. The main objectives for the design engineer shall be 0 Errors, 0 Missed Commitments, and efficient production.
responsibilities: The Engineering Apprentice shall be capable of applying engineering principles, judgment, and knowledge to develop innovative and cost saving solutions for all DIS-TRAN projects.

The Engineering Apprentice shall be responsible for producing accurate and organized structural calculations, for customer review, sizing all structural elements for structures to be fabricated as well as providing reactions for foundation design.
The Engineering Apprentice shall be fully knowledgeable of DIS-TRAN design standards including all applicable building codes and standards relating to physical and structural substation design.

The Engineering Apprentice shall produce efficient steel designs that meet all requirements of building codes, customer specifications, and equipment operational requirements.  The engineer is expected to and be responsible for ensuring that all reasonable efforts are made to keep steel designs within the quoted steel cost.

The Engineering Apprentice shall work hand-in-hand with Structural Design Coordinators to efficiently create accurate structural models to feed the design process.  The engineer is responsible for thoroughly checking all structural models before calculations are submitted for a project.
The Engineering Apprentice shall have adequate Inventor knowledge to be able to create simple structural models and all drawings that go in the structural calculation books.
The Engineering Apprentice shall have a thorough knowledge of all electrical clearance requirements, and assure they are met.
The Engineering Apprentice shall have a thorough knowledge of the function and operation of all substation equipment.  Applying this knowledge is critical to producing adequate structure designs.
The Engineering Apprentice shall have a working knowledge of all engineering software used by DIS-TRAN.
The Engineering Apprentice shall be capable of reviewing/checking the bus design and structural layout for all projects.
The Engineering Apprentice shall be able to produce foundation designs and foundation construction drawings.

The Engineering Apprentice shall be responsible for following the project throughout the design process, support the design team on technical matters, and ensure that their design intent is maintained.
The Engineering Apprentice shall be responsible for helping, including working with project management, to resolve or remove any impediments to the successful completion of the project.

The Engineering Apprentice shall be responsible for knowing and understanding the specifications and/or customer requests – communicating any items that may be easily missed to the design team.  It is expected that the engineer remains in touch with the design team on a periodic basis while the work is ongoing.

The Engineering Apprentice shall proactively schedule any team meetings that may be necessary due to multitudes of customer changes, piecemealed information, a sense of team confusion, conflicting specifications, progress getting off track, etc.  Also, the engineer shall help make any decisions necessary to keep all parts/aspects of the project moving forward.

The Engineering Apprentice shall schedule any necessary check points for drawing and/or drawing package review to ensure the highest quality possible (ex. scheduling a checking session {possibly over lunch} to review the entire drawings package for an EPC job to ensure all changes or modifications along the way were incorporated).

jobgether-jobgether:lever:170f84ad-b664-.title: Google Cloud Delivery Architect
jobgether-jobgether:lever:170f84ad-b664-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Google Cloud Delivery Architect based in Portugal. This is a senior, hands-on cloud architecture role focused on delivering complex Google Cloud engagements from design through implementation and handover. You will take ownership of scoped, fixed-budget projects and translate customer requirements into reliable production environments. The role combines cloud architecture, infrastructure as code, Kubernetes, networking, security, and DevOps expertise. You will work directly with customers, lead technical discussions, and manage several engagements in parallel. You’ll also drive cloud migrations, establish secure landing zones, and modernize infrastructure through automation and GitOps. This is an opportunity to make a direct impact on enterprise cloud transformation while operating with significant technical and delivery ownership. Own the end-to-end delivery of Google Cloud engagements, from low-level design and implementation through validation, documentation, knowledge transfer, and final handover. Design and execute cloud migrations from AWS or Azure to Google Cloud, including production workloads such as EKS to GKE, RDS to Cloud SQL, and S3 to Cloud Storage. Design and implement secure Google Cloud foundations and landing zones covering resource hierarchies, IAM, organization policies, networking, and security controls, with infrastructure codified in Terraform. Architect and deploy production-grade GKE environments, including private clusters, node pools, Workload Identity, Helm-based add-ons, ingress, autoscaling, and Cloud Armor. Enable DevOps and infrastructure automation by importing existing environments into Terraform, developing reusable modules, and implementing CI/CD and GitOps workflows using tools such as GitHub Actions and Argo CD. Manage multiple customer engagements simultaneously, maintaining delivery plans, project hours, scope, budgets, and timelines while identifying risks and budget deviations early. Lead customer-facing workshops, weekly meetings, technical discussions, and handover sessions with engineering teams, technical leaders, and CTO-level stakeholders. Protect project scope through effective change management and ensure that all delivered environments are supported by clear documentation, runbooks, and knowledge transfer. Apply AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully in architecture, implementation, troubleshooting, and delivery workflows while maintaining strong technical judgment and quality standards. Requirements 5+ years of hands-on cloud infrastructure and architecture experience, with deep production experience specifically in Google Cloud. Strong expertise in Terraform, including reusable and modular infrastructure code, remote state management, and importing manually provisioned environments. Proven production experience with Kubernetes and GKE, including private clusters, node pools, autoscaling, RBAC, Workload Identity, Helm, and ingress. Strong knowledge of Google Cloud networking and security, including VPC architecture, Cloud NAT, DNS, VPN, Private Service Connect, firewall policies, IAM, Organization Policies, and Secret Manager. Practical experience with CI/CD and DevOps practices, including GitHub Actions or equivalent, keyless authentication to Google Cloud, container workflows, and GitOps with Argo CD or similar tools. Working knowledge of AWS or Azure, with the ability to understand and assess source-cloud environments as part of migration projects. Strong customer-facing English communication skills, with confidence leading technical workshops, weekly meetings, presentations, and handovers. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple technical engagements, work within defined budgets and scopes, and take ownership of delivery outcomes. Strong architectural thinking, problem-solving ability, documentation skills, and attention to implementation q

jobgether-jobgether:lever:442fcd75-7957-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Partner Enablement Manager based in Canada. This is a senior-level opportunity to shape partner enablement across a global technology ecosystem. You will build scalable training, certification, content, and co-selling programs that accelerate revenue through partners. The role spans external partner enablement as well as internal readiness for sales, solutions engineering, and customer success teams. You will work across channel partners, hyperscalers, global system integrators, and technology ISVs. A major focus will be enabling partners around AI Governance and translating strategic priorities into actionable sales motions. Success will be measured through partner readiness, certification, co-sell engagement, pipeline contribution, and account growth. The environment is remote-first, highly collaborative, data-driven, and well suited to someone who enjoys building programs from the ground up. Design, launch, and continuously improve scalable partner training and certification programs across channel, hyperscaler, global system integrator, and technology ISV ecosystems. Develop role-based learning paths covering product knowledge, messaging, technical capabilities, sales plays, and partner readiness, with AI Governance as a key strategic focus. Manage certification programs end-to-end, including curriculum development, facilitation, assessments, badging, recertification, and performance tracking. Build and maintain partner-facing GTM resources such as joint sales plays, co-sell materials, competitive positioning, product overviews, and objection-handling guides. Own and optimize the partner enablement portal and learning infrastructure, improving adoption, discoverability, and the overall partner experience. Collaborate with Product Marketing and Partner teams to turn product launches and strategic messaging into timely, field-ready enablement programs. Equip internal sales, solutions engineering, and customer success teams with resources covering account mapping, co-selling, joint pipeline management, partner engagement models, referrals, reselling, and co-marketing. Develop account-mapping frameworks and support joint pipeline initiatives between internal field teams and partner sales organizations. Track partner readiness and GTM performance through metrics such as certification completion, partner-sourced pipeline, co-sell engagement, and account depth. Use performance data and stakeholder feedback to identify enablement gaps, prioritize investments, and continuously improve programs. Coordinate multiple programs and stakeholders simultaneously, influencing outcomes across teams and external partners without relying on direct authority. Establish program governance, measure impact, and connect enablement investments to tangible commercial outcomes such as pipeline generation, revenue contribution, and account expansion. Requirements 5+ years of experience in partner enablement, channel enablement, partner programs, or a related role within SaaS or the technology sector. Demonstrated experience designing and delivering scalable partner training and certification programs tied directly to go-to-market outcomes. Experience managing a partner portal, LMS, or similar enablement infrastructure; experience with Impartner is strongly preferred. Strong understanding of channel dynamics, co-sell motions, partner economics, and ecosystem models involving channel partners, hyperscalers, and global system integrators. Hands-on experience with account mapping, joint pipeline programs, and collaboration between vendor sales teams and partner organizations. Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to establish credibility with both senior internal stakeholders and external partners. jobgether-jobgether:lever:5f7c23c9-b5b6-.title: IT Asset Management Executive
jobgether-jobgether:lever:5f7c23c9-b5b6-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an IT Asset Management Executive based in India. This role is responsible for managing the complete lifecycle of IT hardware, software, and related technology assets across the organization. You’ll ensure assets are accurately tracked, properly allocated, maintained, recovered, and securely disposed of when they reach end of life. The position combines inventory management, IT operations, procurement coordination, compliance, reporting, and cross-functional collaboration. You’ll work closely with IT, HR, Finance, Procurement, vendors, OEMs, and business stakeholders to maintain strong asset controls. Your work will directly support operational efficiency, cost management, information security, audit readiness, and asset accountability. The role offers exposure to assets deployed across offices, client sites, project locations, and remote-working environments. It is well suited to an organized and detail-oriented IT professional who takes ownership of processes and enjoys improving operational controls. Manage the IT asset lifecycle: Oversee procurement coordination, receipt, inspection, tagging, allocation, transfer, maintenance, recovery, replacement, decommissioning, and disposal of IT assets. Maintain asset records: Keep accurate and up-to-date records covering make, model, serial number, asset tag, configuration, warranty, location, custodian, status, and other relevant asset information. Manage hardware and software: Track laptops, desktops, servers, monitors, printers, mobile devices, networking equipment, storage devices, accessories, and software licenses. Coordinate asset allocation: Issue assets following the required approval and acknowledgment processes and maintain appropriate handover and return documentation. Support employee lifecycle processes: Coordinate with HR, IT, and managers to allocate assets during onboarding and recover them promptly during transfers and employee exits. Conduct audits and reconciliation: Perform physical asset verification and periodic inventory audits, reconcile physical assets against asset registers, and investigate discrepancies. Track distributed assets: Maintain visibility of technology deployed across offices, client sites, project locations, and remote-working environments. Coordinate with external partners: Work with Procurement, Finance, vendors, and OEMs on purchases, repairs, warranty claims, replacements, leases, and service agreements. Monitor asset maintenance: Track assets under repair and follow up to ensure timely resolution and closure. Manage warranties and renewals: Monitor warranty, AMC, lease, and software license renewal dates and take appropriate action ahead of expiry. Support asset disposal: Maintain records of damaged, lost, stolen, obsolete, and non-functional assets and coordinate approved disposal and e-waste processes. Protect information security: Ensure storage devices are securely erased or destroyed before reassignment or disposal. Monitor software compliance: Maintain software license records and track allocation, utilization, and compliance requirements. Prepare operational reports: Produce regular reports covering inventory, asset allocation, ageing, warranty status, repair activity, and asset availability. Maintain ITSM records: Update asset-related tickets, requests, approvals, and other information within designated ITSM or asset-management systems. Support audits: Assist with internal, client, statutory, and information-security audits by providing accurate asset documentation and records. Improve processes: Identify opportunities to strengthen asset-management procedures, controls, documentation, and overall operational efficiency. Requirements: Education: Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Electronics, Business Administration, or a related discipline. Professional experience:

jobgether-jobgether:lever:7995c979-de2d-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior ML Engineer based in Ireland. This role offers the opportunity to build production-grade AI systems in a high-impact healthcare environment where reliability, evaluation, and safety are essential. You’ll own machine learning initiatives end-to-end, taking complex problems from early exploration through deployment and continuous improvement. A major focus will be designing agentic LLM systems with tool use, retrieval, orchestration, and robust evaluation frameworks. You’ll work across the AI stack, from data preparation and model adaptation to serving, monitoring, and production feedback loops. Close collaboration with Product, Clinical, and Engineering teams will be critical to translating real-world healthcare needs into effective technical solutions. You’ll also contribute to engineering excellence through mentorship, knowledge sharing, and practical adoption of AI across the team. Own machine learning projects end-to-end, from problem exploration and experimentation through production deployment, monitoring, and ongoing iteration. Design and build reliable agentic LLM systems using multi-step workflows, tool calling, retrieval, and orchestration techniques suitable for high-stakes clinical environments. Develop robust evaluation strategies, including evaluation datasets, offline and online testing harnesses, LLM-as-judge pipelines with human review, and regression testing. Improve model performance using evidence-driven approaches such as prompt engineering, retrieval optimization, distillation, fine-tuning, or other appropriate techniques. Partner with Product, Clinical, and Engineering stakeholders to translate clinical requirements into technical solutions and identify trade-offs early. Review code, share technical knowledge, contribute to engineering best practices, and mentor less experienced engineers. Continuously explore and apply AI-assisted approaches that improve individual productivity, team workflows, products, and engineering processes.
